name: Camcorder revival
summary: A 4:3 picture with tape noise, a date stamp and a shaky hand. It looks like a home video from 1985 to 2005. Creators shoot on old Hi8 and MiniDV or add the look in post, to look near and unpolished.

philosophy.core_thesis: A flawed, low-resolution tape image looks like a real memory, so the defect is the proof of the moment.
design_principles: Frame in 4:3 at 640 × 480 px (SD) and keep the 4:3 on a vertical feed with a blurred side fill.
Shoot at 29.97 fps (NTSC) or 25 fps (PAL) in 60i or 50i, with a fixed 1/60 s or 1/50 s shutter and an auto-exposure that pumps by 0.5 to 1 stop.
Add a date stamp or a REC and battery icon in the corner, for example 'NOV 18 2003', at 5% of frame height in orange or white.
Raise the black level to 8% to 10%, clip the highlights at 100% with a bloom of 5 to 10 px, and set saturation at +25%.
Add chroma bleed of 2 to 4 px to the right of red edges, 8% to 15% noise and a tracking glitch of 4 to 12 frames, no more than once a minute.
Hold takes of 8 to 30 s with a handheld, on a wide lens of 35mm to 40mm equivalent, and let the zoom hunt once in a take.
Record the sound on the camera microphone, mono, at about −18 LUFS integrated, with wind and 3 to 6 dB of auto-gain pumping.
anti_patterns: A crisp 4K picture with a flat overlay
A stack of effects on every shot
An even filter with no handheld shake

composition.framing: A casual 4:3 frame with the subject centred and the head cut off at times; the horizon is slightly off level, by 2° to 5°.
composition.staging_in_depth: A subject at 1 to 3 m in a lived-in room or a street; no staged layers.
composition.subject_placement: Centred or wherever the person stands; the operator follows late, by 0.2 to 0.5 s.

principles.rule: Frame in 4:3 with a date stamp in the corner and a head that cuts the top of the frame.
principles.value: head cuts the top 5% to 10%; 1 timestamp in a corner

principles.rule: Centre the person and let the autofocus hunt, so that the focus drifts for 0.5 to 1 s.
Leave dead headroom or a stray ceiling in the frame, as a hand-held amateur does.
Hold one degraded signal look for the whole piece with tape noise, a timestamp and a soft grade.
Hold shots for 6 to 20 s with no cutaway, and let the cut come late.

camera_and_movement.movement: Handheld, with a sudden zoom, a pan to a laugh and a walk. The operator talks off camera.
camera_and_movement.support: Handheld by the strap or the grip
camera_and_movement.camera_height: Chest or eye level, 1.2 to 1.7 m
camera_and_movement.move_speed: Walking pace, 1.0 to 1.5 m/s; zoom hunt of 1 to 2 s

lens_and_format.focal_length: Wide end, about 40mm (35mm format); optical zoom 10× to 20×
lens_and_format.resolution: VHS about 240 lines; Hi8 about 400 lines; MiniDV 720 × 480 px
lens_and_format.focus: Autofocus that hunts, with a soft, low-contrast picture.

light.quality: Whatever is in the room: ceiling light, a flash-like on-camera lamp, the daylight at a window.
light.direction: From above or the front; the face has red-eye or a shine, and the window blows out.
light.colour_temperature: Auto white balance that drifts between 3200K and 5600K
light.source: Room lights, windows and on-camera lamp

colour_and_grade.treatment: Warm, faded and slightly oversaturated, with lifted blacks, soft detail and a colour smear at edges.
grade_recipe: Scale to 640 × 480 px and back to the delivery size with a soft filter.
Lift the black point to 8% to 10% and clip the white point at 100% with a bloom of 5 to 10 px.
Raise saturation by +25%, add a slight green-cyan cast in the shadows of 5% and a warm cast in the highlights of 5%.
Add horizontal chroma bleed of 2 to 4 px and noise of 8% to 15%.
Add scanlines at 10% opacity and a tracking glitch of 4 to 12 frames at most once a minute.
Burn in the date stamp and a REC icon at 5% of frame height.
colour_and_grade.texture: Tape noise, amount 8% to 15%, with scanlines at 10% opacity

editing_and_rhythm.cutting_logic: Cut as if the operator stopped and started the tape: in-camera cuts, a hard start of the next scene, no cut on action.
editing_and_rhythm.transitions: Hard cut with a 2 to 4 frame glitch; a tape rewind or a record flash for a joke.
editing_and_rhythm.runtime: 30 s to 5 min; clips on a feed run 15 to 45 s

sound.approach: Camera microphone only: mono, near and noisy, with a voice off camera and room tone.
sound.dialogue: Casual and overlapping; the operator speaks and laughs.
sound.music: A song that plays in the room, or a radio or a cheap loop; no score.
sound.loudness: −18 LUFS integrated, with 3 to 6 dB of auto-gain pumping

titles_and_graphics.treatment: On-screen camera display: REC dot, battery bar, PLAY arrow and a date stamp; blue screen at tape start.
titles_and_graphics.type: Pixel or monospace display face, white or orange, 4% to 5% of frame height.

shot_primer.opening: Open on a blue tape-start screen for 0.5 s, then a handheld shot with the REC icon and the date stamp.

emotion.target_response: Nostalgia and trust: the viewer feels a real, imperfect memory, not an ad.

use_cases: video prompts for a memory or a party
avoid_when: The brief needs a premium product shot or accurate colour.
The viewer must read small text or detail on a phone.

modifiers.how: Keep the handheld address and the warm light; move to 16:9 4K with clean audio, and drop the tape noise and the date stamp.
Keep the tape colour and the date stamp; move to 9:16, cut at 2 to 4 s and burn in captions.

sources.title: Digital Camera World: From obsolete to obsession, TikTok's retro camcorder boom
